Fits Dell Inspiron 5400, 5406, 5408, 5409, 5500, 5501, 5502, 5508, 5509, Inspiron 7300/7405/7500/7506 2-in-1 (Silver variants only, not the Black 2-in-1 variants), Latitude 3410/3510, and Vostro 5300/5301/5401/5402/5501/5502 (4-cell, 53Wh). faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits a wide range of Inspiron, Latitude and Vostro models — but note that some of these laptops use two different battery shapes (H5CKD 53Wh 4-cell, or JK6Y6 40Wh 3-cell). The part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker on your battery on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.answer: We stock genuine OEM batteries — this is a genuine Dell H5CKD unit.
